subject: Quick follow-up + scheduling: Private VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acmepay.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmepay.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's discovery

Hi Samir / Laura,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to learn more about Acme Payments' fraud detection pipeline and latency requirements. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

- Recap: primary need is low-latency private inference for transaction scoring, full data isolation, and KMS-managed keys for model inputs/outputs. You mentioned regulated PCI-adjacent constraints and a preference for a VPC/on-prem private deployment.
- Ask: next step is a technical architecture review (Private/VPC/on-prem) where our solutions engineer walks through sample network topology, KMS/HSM options, and integration points (VPN/Direct Connect).

Suggested time slots (PST) next week:
- Tue 4/21 10:00–11:00
- Wed 4/22 14:00–15:00

Can you confirm which slot works for your team and who you want on the call (security, infra, SRE)? Also, if you can share any existing network/VPN constraints or a quick diagram ahead of the call, that'd help us tailor the runbook.

I've cc'd Dev Patel (our solutions engineer) who will lead the technical deep dive. I'll follow up with an invite once we confirm a time.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed 4/22 14:00–15:00 PST works best for us. Joining will be:
- Samir Khan (me) – Head of IT
- Laura Chen – Infrastructure Lead
- Michael Reyes – Security Engineer (I'll include him on the invite)

For the agenda, please include:
1) Proposed VPC topology and network flow (including peering / Direct Connect options)
2) KMS/HSM integration and key rotation model
3) Data retention and audit/logging controls (SOC2 considerations)
4) Required artifacts pre-call (if any)

Also: is it possible for Redwood to share a sample network diagram and a short list of the customer-side network prerequisites beforehand? That would let us validate with our infra team.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Thanks Marissa — I'll prepare a proposed VPC template (subnets, routing, firewall rules) and a sample network diagram.

Quick question for Samir / Laura before the call: will you be using Direct Connect, VPN, or an on-prem peering appliance? Also, how many AZs/subnets do you expect the inference workload to run in (1 / 2 / 3)? Knowing that will help size the HA topology.

I'll also include a short list of customer-side prereqs (ports, routes, VPN config) in the pre-read.
